subject: Scheduling: Dedicated capacity sizing call / FintechCo

Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + next step: Dedicated capacity sizing call / FintechCo

Hi Sarah / Liam —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning — great to learn more about FintechCo's roadmap for embedding LLMs into customer support and risk workflows. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Primary use cases: real-time chat for customers (support bot) + nightly batch rerank for fraud signals.
- Ballpark volume: currently ~30k customer interactions / day, with spikes during euro market open.
- Success criteria: p95 latency < 600ms for chat, throughput to sustain peak concurrency.

Next steps: schedule a dedicated capacity sizing call (technical deep dive) with your infra/ML team + our solutions architect (David) to go over throughput, latency SLAs, and deployment options (Dedicated vs Private). Suggested agenda:

1) Quick product recap (10m)
2) Throughput/latency targets, traffic shape, and KV/cache expectations (20m)
3) Deployment & network/region constraints (10m)
4) Sizing recommendations and follow-ups (20m)

Proposed slots (all PT):
- Tue Jul 6: 10:30–11:30am
- Wed Jul 7: 9:00–10:00am or 2:00–3:00pm

If those don't work, share a couple of times that do. I'm attaching the call notes from today's discovery and a short requirements template that will help us size more accurately.

Attachments: fintechco_call_notes.pdf, requirements_template.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to locking something in.

Best,
Camila Reyes

Thanks Camila — really helpful recap. We're definitely interested in a sizing call. A few notes from our side to help scope:

- For chat: rough peak is ~200 requests/sec (RPS) during spikes; typical p95 latency target 500–600ms.
- For batch rerank: nightly jobs process ~4M items, can be scheduled overnight but we'd like throughput estimate and cost ballpark.
- Security: we need region in us-west and SOC2 evidence (happy to get that on the call if needed).

Thanks everyone — I'll join Wednesday's call. A couple of quick asks for prep so we can size accurately:

- Can you paste a short traffic sample (RPS over a 24h window) or an approximate hourly distribution? Even percentiles are fine.
- Confirm if any workloads must stay within us-west and if there are private VPC/peering requirements.
- If available, share a sample request payload size and tokenization expectations (for chat).

I'll prepare a preliminary sizing run and bring three options (reserved Dedicated pool, burstable Reserved + Hosted fallback, and Private deployment) with rough cost per 1M tokens. I'll also drop a one-page mutual action plan into the Drive before the call.

Drive link for MAP: https://drive.google.com/fintechco-dedicated-capacity-notes

-David
